classification: prospective paper engineering/research trial, not deployment of a validated profitable strategy
reason: Historical Timestral portfolio was profitable under its assumptions and within the user risk limit, but both statistical and incremental-value gates failed. This trial obtains genuinely future evidence with no money or orders.

model.target: log(daily close-to-close return squared + 1e-8), two jointly forecast variates
model.variance_rule: sum(exp(median forecast days 2..8)), no subtracting epsilon (conservative floor)

policy: unchanged 126-day trend, 256-day risk context, 8-day model forecast using days 2..8, 52 matured forecast calibration rows, 20% target volatility, maximum 50% per asset, no leverage
execution: paper only: consume public displayed bid/ask depth with fractional quantities; 10bp fee and additional adverse 2bp reserve; self-financing. No actual fills or simultaneous executability claimed.
risk_monitor: daily observed liquidation NAV; when drawdown >=25%, paper-liquidate at available bids and halt that arm. Gaps, latency and exchange outages can cause loss beyond25%; no guaranteed drawdown cap.
source_policy: Public GET-only Binance spot endpoints; retain raw bodies and request/receipt times; RTT<=3s and cross-source collection span<=10s. Check exchange clock offset<=2s before timed decisions.
warmup: 52 most recent historical weekly forecasts with target_end<=activation time, explicitly warmup only. Public prices after July2026 are allowed solely in this NEW trial; old experiment artifacts are not opened. Calendar overlap means old date ranges cannot be called unseen for the overall research programme.
missingness: No retrospective forecasts or entry fills. Late slots recorded missing; prior paper holdings continue until a later valid rebalance or risk liquidation. Any missing primary slot prevents a complete-coverage result.
outcomes: Weekly realized variance added only after target_end using observed daily opening prices; provisional book marks separately labelled. Last exit liquidated using current quotes at actual receipt, with any lateness retained.
reporting: Report Timestral, EWMA and fixed arms together. Paper net trading PnL separate from capital opportunity cost5% annual. Eight weeks are insufficient to establish stable profitability; no threshold or parameter tuning after outcomes.
resource_guard: stop new acquisition on <40GiB available or frozen-code/model mismatch; do not restart legacy services or modify their journals
lifetime: 8 weeks of portfolio exposure; automatic expiry after final exit plus10min; supervision is a bounded local process, not a system service
preactivation_revision: Before any prospective slot/activation: share CLI writer lock, retry transient public source errors, record computations that miss deadlines instead of retroactive decisions, and inspect drawdown before new paper exposure. Old bundle preserved unactivated; strategy and all parameters unchanged.
